final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), above_average AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - o.avg_count AS above_overall FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE oc.order_count > o.avg_count), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM above_average) SELECT a.account_id, a.order_count, a.above_overall, a.order_count - m.avg_count AS above_above_average FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS m ORDER BY above_above_average DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10
